changeSet.author: facilon
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sp_consents_user ( id BIGINT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, tenant_id BIGINT NULL, unique_code VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, consent_version VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, effective_date DATE NOT NULL, ip_address VARCHAR(64), user_agent VARCHAR(512), escalation_name VARCHAR(255), escalation_email VARCHAR(255), escalation_phone VARCHAR(64), consent_given TINYINT(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, INDEX idx_sp_consents_user_unique_code (unique_code), INDEX idx_sp_consents_user_tenant (tenant_id) ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci;

changeSet.author: facilon
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS service_provider_users ( id BIGINT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, tenant_id BIGINT NULL, service_provider_name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, first_name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, last_name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, designation VARCHAR(255), official_email VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, official_phone VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, consent TINYINT(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CONSTRAINT uk_service_provider_users_official_email UNIQUE (official_email), INDEX idx_service_provider_users_tenant (tenant_id) ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci;
